newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said it temporarily added reserves to the banking system on Wednesday via overnight system repurchase agreements.

Fed funds traded at 5-3/8 percent, above target, at 1130 EDT/1530 GMT when the Fed intervened. The pressure stemmed from the last day of the reserve maintenance period and rising demand for currency in circulation ahead of the Labor Day.
Wednesday's operation supplements seven- and three-day system repo operations that are expiring at the start of business on Thursday. -- N.A. Treasury, 212-859-1666
